title: Asiad: Enriquez claims jiu jitsu silver after loss to Thai foe in final
summary: Alexandria Enriquez added a silver medal to the Philippines' tally in the 20th Asian Games on Saturday, losing a tough final to Thailand's Orapa Senatham in the women's -63kg class in jiu jitsu.
